channel: allcoredevs/_threads/When is the last date for EIPs_
searchText: Wasn't the deadline moved until the next acde? Beginning of ACDC (August 6) was apparently the deadline. You needed to have it on the ACDE agenda or have a PR to the upgrade EIP Ansgar at last ACDE: https://forkcast.org/calls/acde/242/#t=1939 Suggest adding your EIP to the ACDE agenda and check with ACD call moderators. https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12130
